stories.headline: 'I've applied for more than 400 roles' - how young people are facing the job shortage
stories.summary: The BBC has been hearing from young people who are struggling to find work about how they are tackling the challenge.

voices.student_north: Bhai 400 applications? Mujhe toh abhi 47 rejections mil chuke hain aur main soch raha hoon ki 400 try karun. At this rate, mere CV ko LinkedIn se zyada profile views milenge than actual job offers. Placement coordinator ne kaha — "Keep applying," matlab "Keep suffering.
voices.student_south: Bhai 400 applications. Mera placement coordinator: "Just attend interviews, confidence rakho." 400 rejections later, confidence dead. Meanwhile that one professor still hasn't passed anyone from our batch. At least he's consistent. Job market mein aur consistent koi nahi.
voices.professional_north: Bhai 400 applications? Mere company mein ek opening hai — 600 log ne apply kiya. Iska matlab jo already job mein hai, uska matlab woh lottery jeet gaya. Ab samajh aaya kyun boss mere 5 pending tasks par pressure daal raha hai — replace karne ke liye queue mein already 500 log khade hain!
voices.professional_south: Bhai, 400 applications? Even my resume isn't that hardworking. Meanwhile mera boss thinks I'm irreplaceable — clearly he hasn't seen the job market. 400 rejections se accha hai appraisal season mein ek boss se rejection le lete hain, atleast free coffee toh milta hai office mein.

Aur yeh "global economic turmoil" matlab ek hi baat — hamara salary same, but everything else became premium. Boss ko bhi five-pound coffee chahiye, hum instant nescafe pe hi adjust kar rahe hain.

stories.summary: With US waiting staff getting cross at receiving less than 20%, tips are also on the rise elsewhere.

voices.student_north: Arre yeh American tipping culture ab India mein bhi aa jayega na. Already pizza delivery boy ko 50 rupees tip chahiye, waiter ko 100. Aur hum PGDM ke baad bhi broke rahenge. Tipping culture spread hona chahiye — shaadi mein dulha ko tip de denge, shaadi cancel ho jayegi.
voices.student_south: Bro US se tipping culture aa gaya India mein. Soon tera canteen wala demanding 20% tip after giving cold samosa. College placement interview mein bhi interviewer bolega "acha beta, tip de do". Apna already broke hain, ab tip dene ka paisa kahan se aayega?
voices.professional_north: Bhai, ab India mein bhi tipping culture spread ho gaya. Restaurant mein 20% tip dena padega, cab mein 15%, delivery boy ko extra — salary toh same hai, par har jagah khule haath se nikalna padega. Boss: "Inflation se bachne ke liye smart ho jao." Mein: "Sir, mere paas sirf notes hain, sense nahi.
voices.professional_south: Arre, American tipping culture idhar bhi aa gaya? Kal coffee machine pe barista ko 20% tip dena padega, nahi to disappointed face. Already salary mein se kuch nahi bachta, ab tips bhi mandatory ho jayega. Boss: Work karo. Barista: Tip karo. Mere paas to bas air hi bacha hai donate karne ke liye.

stories.headline: Ten years of recovery: How a bankruptcy legislation turned India's banks around
stories.summary: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code framework's biggest achievement has been shifting power from defaulting promoters to creditors, altering borrowing and lending behaviour across the system.

voices.student_north: Bhai, bankruptcy code ne finally defaulting promoters ko maar diya. Ab creditors ko power hai. Maza toh tab aayega jab hamare future boss ka startup fail ho aur hum apna pending salary recover kar sakein. Abhi toh bas hope hai.
voices.student_south: Bhai bankruptcy code pass ho gaya toh defaulters finally pakde ja rahe hain. Iska matlab tumhare college placement company jo salary promise kar ke disappear ho jaata hai — uske against ab action possible hai. Acha news, par tumhara startup idea padega toh first loss hi hoga.
voices.professional_north: Yaar bankruptcy code ne finally defaulters ko suppress kar diya — ab loan dena padega return karna hi padega. Hamara boss bhi apni salary default na kar de, kyunki hum to already insolvent hain EMI aur rent se. Code promoters ko maar raha hai, hume to sadiyaan lagegi.
voices.professional_south: Bankruptcy code ne finally defaulters ko thik kiya. Iska matlab ab boss ka "project delay" excuse nahi chalega — woh bhi technically insolvent ho sakta hai. Ten years lagaye sirf yeh samjhane ke liye ki rupees actual value rakhte hain, not just PowerPoint slides.
